No video, turn on your air unit
Video cannot start on this phone. See Diagnostics in the menu for details.
First time? Open the menu (top right), About for goggle setup.
MissingLynk shows your FPV goggle\'s live video on your phone so you can screen-share it (for example to Twitch).

Using the MissingLynk desktop tool, enable these components and power-cycle the goggle:

• rtsp: the video server
• ecm: lets Android see the USB network
• dhcp: gives your phone an address

Connect the goggle to your phone with a USB-A to USB-C OTG adapter. A plain USB-C to USB-C cable will not work, the phone will not act as the USB host. The app then finds the goggle and starts the video on its own.

Power on your air unit so it transmits. If you see \"No video, turn on your air unit\", the goggle is connected but nothing is streaming yet. The feed keeps reconnecting on its own, so battery swaps are fine.
If the goggle ever misbehaves, hold its BACK button while powering on to boot stock (without MissingLynk).
No need to change this unless you know what you are doing.

Paste the full ingest URL with your stream key on the end, for example rtmp://live.twitch.tv/app/YOUR-KEY. Add ?bandwidthtest=true to test against Twitch Inspector without going live. The key is hidden once saved and is kept out of the diagnostics log.

The broadcast always carries an audio track: it is what keeps the connection open while the video drops, which happens on every battery swap. Silence is a generated track. Microphone picks up the room, including anything playing on a speaker.
Microphone access is needed to send audio. Audio stays silent.
No destinations yet. Add one to stream a session.
A destination needs an rtmp:// or rtmps:// URL
No video from the air unit
Set a streaming destination in Settings first
This destination needs H.264. The goggle is sending H.265; change DVR > Codec on the goggle.
The destination rejected the stream key. Check it in Settings > Streaming destination.
That stream key is already live. Stop whatever else is broadcasting to it, then start again.
That URL is incomplete. Check the destination in Settings > Streaming destination.
Could not reach the destination. Check the server URL, and that this phone has an internet connection.
The destination refused the secure connection. Check its certificate, or use rtmp:// if it does not offer TLS.
Streaming failed and is retrying. See Diagnostics in the menu for details.
